name: scramjet
description: ESM stream framework built on Scramjet Core for Node.js.

scripts.build: npm run clean && node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --include="dist/**/*.js" --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --reports-dir=coverage node --test test/*.test.js
